dedupe_keys.name: enhanced treated drinking water data sheets

description: Enhanced treated drinking water [data sheets] is a dataset listed in Alberta open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environment and Sustainable Resource Development. Enhanced water quality monitoring programs for both ambient (raw) water in rivers, streams and reservoirs, and treated drinking water were implemented in response to the 2013 flood events in southern Alberta. These data sheets present the results of the monitoring for treated drinking water, which was undertaken between July 2 and July 31, 2013. Coverage: Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Environment and Sustainable Resource Development. Its tags are 2013 flood recovery, drinking water, drinking water systems, water quality. It offers 42 resource(s) in PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2023-09-08 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-alberta-portal.
